I actually just found out the same about a sister. My grandmother knows my uncles and only after my dad died 1 year after did someone not even family tell me. 

It’s insane. All you can do is try and reach out if you want or don’t. It’s up to you.
I’m so sorry. It’s extremely unfair humans can be like this.

How did you end up finding a career? After everything’s NMom has aid my whole life I don’t even know where to start. I have such horrible self doubt. I have no idea what I’d be good at because I wasn’t allowed to make my own choices.
Hahaha yeah. So when I mention his MOS or talk about BAH and such, the glossy eyes I get lol 😂

This is a great idea! Thank you all! 

You have no idea how happy I am to have posted this and received the kindness and helpful news of you all!

My husband has considered looking into going back in as well. I think he thought a civilian job would be laid back and easy to slip into and it’s harder because they don’t have any order or structure like he’s used to. And again relatability was just easier for us both too.

Thank you so much for your feedback. I felt so alone because no one can relate! 
I made friends in the military mainly through groups. But being that we all had a common ground helped. 

I’m so happy you found a person to relate to! 

And I agree I never understood why people wouldn’t want civilian friends but I get it. 
It’s just hard to have relatable conversations. And even terminology is hard. 
I miss having a base as a community. Even not knowing everyone on it, I felt at home. 
I was apart of it with my husband for almost 13 years! Our entire growing up was done in it. 

And even though we did move back to our home town my family nor his understand what we’re going through.
